fusions.name: Wring Out
fusions.desc: Squeezes the target, using up one of your afflictions on it to deal 8 damage and leave it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Let Go
fusions.desc: Reaches out up to 4 tiles to an enemy at or below 30% health and deals 26 damage. It moves 40% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hang and Rest
fusions.desc: You hang by your grip and rest, restoring 3 stamina a second for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Tightening Grip
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 3% more damage per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
